org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model

Class CameraState

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model.CameraState

  • @Entity
public class CameraState
extends Object
    Database Entity representing the CameraState table. Each record is a snapshot of the camera state, typically taken when a frame is being taken.

    smichaels

      • CameraState

        public CameraState(org.tmt.aps.peas.extinf.CameraStatus cameraStatus)
        Constructs a CameraState from a CameraStatus object.

      • CameraState

        public CameraState(Instrument instrument)
        Constructs a CameraState from an Instrument. Descends the instrument reference tree to each component and reads state information from transient fields into this instance. This is useful when creating a CameraState to assign to a CcdFrame: if the passed instrument is 'live', i.e. a reference to the Instrument in the {#link PhysicalModel} then the most recent camera state can be stored without an additional I/F query, which could add time to CCD reads.
        Parameters:
        instrument - the instrument object to read state from
